test_title: PYST 61: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is

different.

Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) BEH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a9a727805de64609c62e7505959ba91cf4965db69b98f47fef53d80414a00fd.png] 

Option 2) SVY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0da5a4399a7cd65f3a6f042d0efa2ca77806ad8abd2fec0ae7b5d166093d2306.png] 

Option 3) ILN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5228fbb707717eca40fb0e93b319d71f33b4a17d2b1b91d0f2504e2518b297ca.png] 

Option 4) KNQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9086b0348cb8a12da8f3178a2318c8fbfb2e7146bd861a1486d5a80fe0a10677.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'ILN' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
